meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (한빛시 자전거 리포트 2026, a city cycling report with fictional data). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 한빛시 자전거 리포트 2026, a city cycling report with fictional data
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: A paper map: ground #F4EFE6 with a faint 48 px grid, ink #23262B; the data in the classic infographic run navy #234E70, steel #5C8DA8, teal #2A9D8F and a red-orange #E76F51 that is kept for the news (the 2026 bar, ×2, 112km, 12%, the core line). Water #BFD9E6, parks #CFE3B4, roads #E2D6C1.
rationale.type: Gothic A1 at 800-900 for every word and number, so a figure reads from across a room; labels at 30-44 px in 700. Lines rise out of a mask on an expo ease.
rationale.motion: Data that builds: the city assembles block by block, bars grow out of the ground a beat apart with a small overshoot, numbers count up while they grow, a dashed trend line draws to a ×2 badge, bike lanes draw themselves and riders run along them, hubs pulse. Scenes push in from the side.
rationale.sound: Corporate at 128 BPM in D major (8 bars in 15 s, 16 in 30 s): piano and strings, a light kit; glassy SFX: a count roll under every number, pops for bars and badges.
rationale.visuals: All code: an isometric map (plate, road grid, river, parks, blocks), isometric bars, a donut, a timeline, a bicycle with turning wheels, and the 가상 데이터 label on every chart.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the numbers are on screen; a public-screen version plays muted.
